title: Bistro Match Pop
description: Match sizzling burgers, desserts, and gourmet ingredients in a cheerful restaurant puzzle—chain power-up combos to satisfy VIP orders and renovate your diner.
controls: Swap or tap matching food tiles to clear order targets and trigger explosive kitchen boosters.
